# MERP-UI 2.0.8 — More Readable Talents & Flaws on RMU Character Sheets

This update delivers the **cosmetic improvement validated by the module author** in the GATES - RACES LIGHT TEST World.

### A more compact Talents & Flaws tab

- The rich description of each Talent or Flaw now uses **PragRoman at 13 px**, matching the character sheet instead of the larger Item-sheet typography.
- Long descriptions appear as a **short preview (up to approximately 150 characters)**, reducing the vertical space consumed by individual Talents.
- A bilingual **Read description / Lire la description** control expands or collapses the original full text.
- The enhancement follows MERP-UI's **Content Language** and works when the Talents tab is rendered after the sheet is first opened.
- All native RMU columns remain visible, including Talent name, tier, restricted modifiers, tier costs and Development Point totals. Native edit/remove controls are untouched.

### Display-only and backward compatible

- No changes to **RMU rules**, Talent purchases, Development Point calculations, Actor/Item documents, or existing character data.
- No changes to the nine existing **MERP-RMU LevelDB Compendiums**, source texts, or translations.
- Includes the 2.0.7 improvements to character creation and Compendium typography.
- No migration is needed.

**Verified by the author in Foundry VTT V14 / RMU 1.4.99:** two Talent descriptions detected, two enhanced, and two preview controls present. The on-screen result was approved.

### Download and update

Install/update through Foundry using the [MERP-UI module manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blackbiji/merp-ui/main/module.json), or download the **full** `merp-ui-2.0.8.zip` attachment to this release (including all nine Compendiums).

MERP-UI is a free, unofficial, non-commercial Middle-earth fan project for Rolemaster Unified. See the repository NOTICE for credits and rights.
